            text = lyd_c3_challenger_has_head_tt
            exists = faith.religious_head
            exists = faith.religious_head_title

        # Match the backend's existing nonempty-scope guard before reading the incumbent.
        trigger_if = {
            limit = { exists = faith.religious_head exists = faith.religious_head_title exists = faith.religious_head_title.holder }
            faith.religious_head = {
                custom_description = {
                    text = lyd_c3_challenger_head_alive_tt
                    is_alive = yes

                custom_description = {
                    text = lyd_c3_challenger_head_faith_tt
                    faith = root.faith
                }
            }
            faith.religious_head_title = {
                custom_description = {
                    text = lyd_c3_challenger_head_holder_tt
                    holder = root.faith.religious_head
                }
            }
            custom_description = {
                text = lyd_c3_challenger_not_head_tt
                this != faith.religious_head
            }
        }
        trigger_else = {
            custom_description = {
                text = lyd_c3_challenger_head_holder_tt
                always = no
            }
        }
        custom_description = {
            text = lyd_c3_challenger_actor_tt
            lyd_c3_player_actor_trigger = yes
        }
        custom_description = {
            text = lyd_c3_challenger_not_antipope_tt
            pam_is_antipope_trigger = no

        custom_description = {
            text = lyd_c3_challenger_not_sponsor_tt
            pam_is_antipope_sponsor_trigger = no
        }
        custom_description = {
            text = lyd_c3_challenger_duchy_tt
            highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy
        }
        custom_description = {
            text = lyd_c3_challenger_capital_tt
            exists = capital_county
        }
        custom_description = {
            text = lyd_c3_challenger_head_type_tt
            faith = { OR = { has_doctrine_parameter = temporal_head_of_faith has_doctrine_parameter = spiritual_head_of_faith } }
        }
        rite = {
            custom_description = {
                text = lyd_c3_challenger_rite_head_tt
                NOT = { rite_has_parameter = no_head_of_faith }
            }
            custom_description = {
                text = lyd_c3_challenger_gender_tt
                rite_has_allowed_gender_for_clergy = root
            }
        }
        custom_description = {
            text = lyd_c3_challenger_no_council_tt
            NOT = { has_variable = lyd_c3_active }
        }
        custom_description = {
            text = lyd_c3_challenger_no_title_tt
            NOT = { has_variable = lyd_c3_claim_title }
        }
        custom_description = {
            text = lyd_c3_challenger_no_proposal_tt
            faith = {
                NOT = { any_faith_rite = { OR = { has_variable = lyd_c2_proposal_owner has_variable = lyd_c3_proposal_owner has_variable = lyd_i3b_owner } } }
            }
        }
